completion_rule: A required item is complete when it is verified, explicitly classified as not publicly recoverable/query-dependent, or excluded/downgraded because evidence does not support the stronger claim. Generic pending values are not allowed in core release logic.

release_integrity_rules: Never replace a classified unavailable value with a guess.
Never use legacy PEP data as revised-series data.

Never present a diagnostic probe as a validated assessment or a one-answer diagnosis.
Keep teacher-facing copy direct, educational and non-promotional.
